evidence.observation: Pressure gauge and exhaust oxygen sensor are not installed; tube pressure and purge/atmosphere quality cannot be verified.
Thermocouple reads 749.6 °C against a 750.0 °C growth setpoint, following stabilization after the growth-entry overshoot.
Measured argon flow is 100.1 sccm against a 100.0 sccm setpoint; inlet flow alone does not verify tube atmosphere or exhaust patency.
Heater power is 44.8% and controller reports running; these do not establish pressure or oxygen conditions.

args.missing_evidence: Independent tube-pressure and exhaust-oxygen measurements are needed to verify growth atmosphere and gas-path conditions; sample characterization is needed to assess target growth.
